archetypes.name: dyn-hook-parity
archetypes.rationale: Changed hook parity coverage should be reviewed against the duplicated helper contract.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the hook clone-ownership parity harness and its sibling documentation. Confirm the newly guarded helpers are the exact verbatim duplicates that should stay byte-identical across the two hook scripts. Check that the harness still fails on missing helpers and drift without broadening scope to intentionally renamed helper pairs. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
